description: Sends recruiter outreach to a talent-search candidate. Without confirm=true it returns a preview and sends nothing; with confirm=true it sends an email through Jobiba (limits: 20 per day, 2 per candidate per 30 days). The candidate's contact details are never exposed.

confirm.description: true only after explicit user approval.

jobId.description: Jobiba job ID (the id field from search_jobs or list_my_jobs).

message.description: Message (20+ chars). Be specific and honest about the role.

name: message_candidate
title: Message a candidate
